objective: Test whether panel-level OI diagnostics can identify when to retain broad RFF and when to apply the fixed 50/50 broad-SAVE pool reranking.
scope: Post-outcome developmental leave-dataset-out diagnostic over two dataset groups. It is not confirmation and cannot authorize integration.

feature_constraints.allowed_source: Only broad-RFF and SAVE selector diagnostics from the current panel

gate_model.type: closed-form ridge regression with unpenalized intercept
gate_model.target: broad top-five mean regret minus 50/50-blend top-five mean regret; positive means blend
gate_model.feature_standardization: training-group mean and population standard deviation; zero scales replaced by one
gate_model.prediction_rule: blend only when predicted benefit > 0; ties retain broad

oracle_panel_gate: Descriptive upper bound choosing lower realized top-five regret per panel; never eligible or deployable.

bootstrap.unit: joint replicate-seed block across all three target families

decision_rule.primary: upper95 reliability-gate-minus-broad top-five mean utility regret < 0
safety: all 90 method-panel rows and all 15 gate predictions are complete and finite
held-out outcome mutations cannot change held-out feature vectors or gate predictions
decision_rule.interpretation: A pass would justify freezing a gate for a future untouched dataset, not validate it on unseen data.
